Concept: Meru Prastara — staircase of Mount Meru; why row totals double
Trigger: Why does each row of Pascal's triangle double: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16?
Gold dialogue: S: I built the triangle — 1, then 1 1, then 1 2 1. Why do the row totals double?|N: First, that staircase has an older name. The scholar Halayudha drew it in the tenth century and called it Meru Prastara — the staircase of Mount Meru — built from nothing but addition, starting from a single one.
